# TASK-119 — Ollama connection and ingestion reliability

- **Status:** In progress — implemented, verification incomplete
- **Area:** Product follow-up (requested 2026-09-28)

## Intent

Improve Ollama/model health, capabilities, structured-output handling, errors and operator guidance; use repeatable tests rather than assuming a model is reliable.

## What it delivers

Conversation: streaming replies, model warm-up (`/agent/warm`, keep_alive 30 min), embedding models hidden from the picker, tool-capability detection, structured fact extraction with cut-off recovery for models without tool calling, compact outline for small windows, readable unreachable-server errors. Verified with gemma2:2b on CPU. Hardware/model guidance remains.
